report_type_conflict renders both types before its symbol/non-symbol forms and explicitly preserves expected/actual/symbol text lookup order. Null-symbol branch uses the callers supplied name; whole RET20 includes the unvisited symbol branch.

report_declaration_error delegates to the separate named report_type_syntax_error when storage flag0x10 is clear. Its other branch builds a storage string from the three logical storage bytes, with existing token_names[TOK_TYPE] fallback. Original high argument byte is not consumed by build_storage_text; no copied opaque storage snapshot.

report_type_syntax_error renders the type and releases its declaration-text scope after the error. report_symbol_error reports the name once and sets the symbol error bit only afterward. No new global arrays or diagnostic-message bulk copy.

Both preflight sources/outputs are retained; adjustment happened before transport freeze. Cast error uses the already reconstructed conversion_diagnostic, not extra credit for report_type_syntax_error.

Independent unmasked original finish observation proves cast_probe then recovered_tail complete and reset function_symbol. Final native GDB observation matches both names, full scanner/parser words at entry and return, complete artifacts/status/streams. Exact browser tail/error marker is retained.
